properties.description: Increment 1 of epoch:planned-cognition-plus-memory. The measurement Anthony chose to start with: one ordinary model (Sonnet), 6 batches of documents, a fresh agent per batch, a seventh answers 25 questions from the memory alone. Arms: A hand-forward summary, B notes file, C reflow2 (logged), D one agent reading everything. Scored blind against a key. Predictions registered before the first run. Also records, for arm C, which reflow2 cues each agent saw and whether it acted on them: the baseline for increment 2. Arrives when the scores and the recall counts are recorded as a measured finding beside the predictions. Not in it: changing any cue.
